name: Gas Processing & Multi-Stage Compression Package
description: Natural gas compression and conditioning train featuring suction knockout drum, high-ratio centrifugal gas compressor, shell-and-tube aftercooler, high-pressure separator, and automated anti-surge recycle loop.
author: NebuDCS Standard Library
thermodynamic_requirements: Polytropic Head and Compression Work Curves
control_strategies: PIC-301 Gas Header Discharge Pressure Control
TIC-301 Gas Aftercooler Outlet Temperature Control via Cooling Water
LIC-301 Suction Knockout Drum Condensate Drain Level Control
validation_rules: VLD-GAS01: Gas compressor must have automated anti-surge recycle or bypass stream
VLD-GAS02: Gas compressor suction must be preceded by liquid knockout protection
